This lane derives the unload's law, ships ONE deadline law that makes the alternation fire the standing hind AT the other's landing, and re-runs the fence. THREE PARTS. (1) THE UNLOAD'S LAW, MINED on the wave-31 shipped trace (the byte-exact 4b05764f reproduction, first walk run, the declared script .tmp/w32_receipt/mine_unload.py): around the L's 160 completion the standing R's share collapsed 7.473@158 -> 3.795@159 -> 1.595@160 -> 0.000@161 N while the landing L's rose 3.996@159 -> 16.348@160 -> 42.254@178 N -- the R's rxn first reads EXACTLY 0 at tick 161 = the L's band entry (160) + 1, and the R's pads left the band AT THAT SAME TICK (pair-min 0.0782 mm @161 > kTouch): THE +1 CLASS -- a standing hind's pads survive exactly one tick past its share's vanish, and the vanish lands one tick past the other's band entry. THE CONTROL ERA: around the R's 107 completion the standing L's share HELD (49-86 N through [107,125], ZERO ticks at rxn 0 in [107,142)) -- the L's pads never lifted at the R's landing: the entry-era seat (this leg has completed NO step-replant) survives the other's landing; the RIDE era (both hinds have completed a step-replant) does not. THE MECHANISM (the wave-30/31 measured letters): a railed or entry-seated knee cannot track the designed columns (the L's band-A rail [107,117]); a sub-cap REPLANTED leg's wave-27 ff tracks them the moment its share vanishes, and the columns lift the unloaded pad (the wave-30 bracket's own measured face). (2) THE DEADLINE LAW, SHIPPED (gait_controller.hpp, hind_alt_due + the fire block): the alternation fire deadline becomes min(the other's last_td + kFoldBudgetTicks - tair - g (the wave-29 fold-budget form, unchanged), THE STANDING LEG'S OWN UNLOAD BOUND), where the unload bound is the DERIVED +1 class (kUnloadTicks = 1, the mined law above) minus the machinery's own hand-off g=1 -- i.e. the unload bound reads the OTHER'S BAND ENTRY TICK ITSELF: the fire must PRECEDE the unload, and the unload is at entry+1, so the window is exactly the entry tick. THE UNLOAD TERM ARMS ONLY IN THE RIDE ERA (hind_step_last_td_[hl] != 0: this leg has completed at least one step-replant) -- the mined control era is the arming's own basis; disarmed, the deadline is the wave-29 fold form EXACTLY, which preserves the whole fence calendar (the L's 108..141 due arithmetic and its 142 deadline fire are byte-identical: the L had completed no replant through 142). The skew-repair clause ('last_td != 0 returns false') is REMOVED -- its premise (the re-synced clock's natural slot arrives within the budget) is falsified by the strand face: the R's re-synced slot read ~252 against a window that closed at 161. The concentration clause flips '<=' to '<' -- the EXCHANGE's own signature (the other's fire on the same tick as this leg's landing) concentrates the ride; byte-identical through 159 (both legs' equal-case never arises before 160). THE HAND-OFF CLAUSE (b) YIELDS TO THE DEADLINE FIRE (new, counted): the wave-29 letter '(a)/(b) NEVER yield' held because the fold deadline (+35) never collides with (b)'s one-tick window -- provably inert there still; the armed unload deadline IS the entry tick, the very tick (b) guards, so (b)'s guard would consume the whole window the law exists to spend. Clause (a) (the no-double-step) NEVER yields. Zero new numeric constants: kUnloadTicks=1 is the mined +1 class, g=1 is the machinery's own hand-off. (3) THE INTERACTION -- THE HANDED SWING-STANCE EXCHANGE: the fired leg's own glide-return (the wave-31 law) completes its landing while the former standing leg -- now the SOLE CARRIER -- is LOADED (its share RISES as the swing leg's pads clear: the unload-lift mechanism needs a vanishing share, and the carrier's share grows), so the carrier's pad holds; at the swing leg's band entry the roles hand over IN THE SAME TICK (the (b)-waived exchange fire) -- the alternation becomes a true handed swing-stance exchange, the gait's first full cycle pattern.
